verdict.rationale: Gecko documents automated fix pull requests and suggested patches, but only for code-level findings traced from source to sink in first-party code. Nothing in the evidence covers dependency or SCA scanning, vulnerable package detection, or upgrade-path recommendations, so the fix-PR feature is adjacent rather than support for remediating vulnerable dependencies.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get concrete upgrade paths or automated fix pull requests that remediate vulnerable dependencies
